description: Daemon that ingests live MCP threat intelligence from public sources and writes to mcp_threat_associations via write_service. Sources: (1) query world_articles table WHERE topics LIKE '%cybersecurity%' AND title LIKE '%mcp%' OR title LIKE '%model context%' - extract threat indicators. (2) Poll https://api.osv.dev/v1/query POST json={package:{name:'mcp',ecosystem:'npm'}} for CVEs. (3) Check npm registry for @modelcontextprotocol packages with recent publish dates and flag sudden version bumps. For each threat found: write to mcp_threat_associations {server_id, threat_type, evidence, severity: CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW, reported_at}. Also write mesh_event 'threat_intel_ingested' with count. Heartbeat to service_health. Run every 2 hours as daemon.
context: This feeds the signal_analyser community_signal dimension. Threat types: CVE_DISCLOSED, RUG_PULL_DETECTED, SUPPLY_CHAIN_COMPROMISE, PROMPT_INJECTION_PATTERN, SUSPICIOUS_PUBLISH. Severity mapping: CVE CVSS>8=CRITICAL, CVSS>5=HIGH, else MEDIUM. Rug pull=HIGH. Supply chain=CRITICAL.
